articles.title: Cameroon Lines Up CFA253 Billion in IsDB Deals, but Firm Funding Remains Unclear
articles.description: The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Group plans to sign financing agreements and letters of intent worth a combined €385.85 million, or CFA253.1 billion, in Cameroon on September 14, 2026. The package could channel funding toward public projects and businesses, although its composition will determine how much represents firm new financing. The documents are expected to be signed in Yaoundé at the end of an IsDB Group Day dedicated to Cameroon, according to information released ahead of the event. No breakdown by project, beneficiary or financial instrument has been published. The CFA253.1 billion therefore cannot yet be treated as new funding already available to the Cameroonian economy. The total combines financing agreements and letters of intent, which carry different levels of commitment. It could also include sovereign loans, credit lines for banks or businesses, trade finance and insurance instruments. Disbursement schedules, maturities, costs and any guarantees have not been disclosed. Two Public Projects Already at an Advanced Stage The largest known public-sector financing involves the rehabilitation of the Douala-Bafoussam road. articles.title: “International coaches unable to communicate well with our Indian kids”- Sanjiv Goenka on possible shake-up in LSG coaching staff
articles.description: Following a dismal last-place finish in the Indian Premier League (IPL 2026), Lucknow Super Giants (LSG) owner Sanjiv Goenka has hinted at a significant reorganization of the team's backroom coaching staff. He claimed that one of the things he learned during the previous IPL season was that the language barrier prevents foreign coaches from effectively communicating with the Indian players. Lance Klusener of South Africa is the assistant coach, Kane Williamson of New Zealand is the mentor, Justin Langer of Australia is the head coach of LSG, and Tom Moody is the global director of cricket. However, this bloated staff has brought some criticism as well, as ex-captain Rishabh Pant, who has been traded to Delhi Capitals, spoke multiple times about dealing with ‘too many’ voices. “ Eventually, a team might look very good on paper. If it doesn’t click, the team doesn’t do well. If an average team on paper clicks, it does very well. Honestly, we haven’t sat down with the coaches yet. A review is yet to be done. The Hundred will finish soon; after that, we will do it. Then we will conclude what happened, why it happened, and what mistakes we shouldn’t repeat. But our batting is also good. Bowling is also good. Last year, our batting clicked, and bowling flopped. This year, our bowling clicked, and batting flopped. So, something needs to be reset. What exactly needs to be done? We have Tom Moody, Kane Williamson, and Justin Langer. We need to talk to them. We need to do a review and then come to a decision on what to do ,” LSG owner Sanjiv Goenka said on the Shubhankar Mishra podcast . Goenka acknowledged that there was a linguistic barrier between the primarily Indian team and the foreign coaches. “ It does cause issues... This is one of my learnings: international coaches are not able to communicate effectively with our Indian kids. They understand the cricketing language, but they don’t understand what goes beyond that. So, this is something that might need to be corrected moving forward ," he added. LSG had made it into the IPL playoffs in both of their first two IPL seasons in 2022 and 2023 under KL Rahul’s captaincy. However, since IPL 2024, LSG has finished 7th twice and 10th in IPL 2026.

articles.title: Omnia receives R21.8bn buyout bid from India-headquartered group
articles.description: JSE- and A2X-listed Omnia has announced that Solar SA Investments has made an offer to acquire all of Omnia’s issued ordinary shares in an all-cash transaction valued at R21.8-billion, after which Omnia’s shares will be delisted from the JSE and A2X markets. This follows only days after Omnia on September 11 informed shareholders that it was in discussions with a then unnamed party regarding a potential offer.
